body: Gemini for Business: The Universal Work Agent | Google Cloud Meet Gemini. ﻿One universal agent for the way you work. Gemini works across your email, docs, code, data, and business apps, so you can hand off the work instead of supervising it. Contact sales 1:42 Don’t let more agents make more work for you. Today almost every tool has an agent. Each one knows a sliver of your business and none of them talk to each other. You end up managing agents instead of the agents managing the work. Gemini is one agent that knows how you work, everywhere you work. There is no platform to stand up and no agent to assemble. You turn it on and it starts working with what you already have. One window for all of it. Ask a question, draft the campaign, analyze the data, ship the code. Same prompt box, same context, same agent. pause Gemini is always up to speed. You never have to brief it on the business. It knows your pricing, product lines, how your team actually works, and learns from every interaction. From a quarter-end financial review to an RFP, teach Gemini once and it delivers every one after the same way. It remembers tasks, facts, and methods across devices and channels. Lengthy jobs run on their own secure machine in Google Cloud. So even if you log off for the day, you know Gemini will have it done when you get back. pause You hold the keys. Gemini runs under each person's existing permissions, approved by your security team, and leaves a complete audit trail. Set a budget cap per project and your agent pauses instead of overspending. Any costs track to each team. pause The best model for the job. Even when it isn't ours. Frontier models, open models, or the one you trained yourself, all under one set of permissions and one bill. Gemini routes each job to whichever fits, so you pay frontier rates only where they earn it while smaller models return routine work faster. An agent is only as good as the stack it's built on. Our chips are designed for our models. Our models are grounded in your data. The agent is built on both, and secured by the infrastructure underneath. Google is the only cloud that provides it all. Gemini plugs into what you’re already using. Microsoft 365, Slack, Confluence, Google Workspace, GitHub, Jira, Salesforce, ServiceNow, BigQuery, HubSpot, Notion, Asana. Gemini works inside the documents, the inbox, and the developer environments you already use under each person's existing permissions. pause FAQ Expand all What is Gemini for business? Gemini is one universal agent for the way you work. When using Gemini at work, it operates across your email, docs, code, data, and business apps across web, desktop, and mobile, so you can hand off the work instead of supervising it. There is no platform to stand up and no agent to assemble: you turn it on and it starts working with what you already have from the same prompt box, with the same shared context. Do I have to move our data into Google? No. Gemini indexes selected sources while keeping data where it lives, and access strictly follows each user's existing permissions. Over 100 supported integrations like Google Workspace (Docs, Gmail, and Drive), Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, and OneDrive), Slack, Confluence, Notion, Jira, Linear, Monday, Asana, Smartsheet, GitHub, GitLab, Salesforce, HubSpot, ServiceNow, Docusign, and BigQuery. Who owns our data, and does Google use my data to train models? When using Gemini for your business, Gemini is built on Google Cloud’s secure-by-design infrastructure, giving you the peace of mind to deploy AI across your organization confidently: You own your data, not Google Your data, including prompts, outputs, and model tuning, is never used to train Google models or models for any other customer Google never sells customer data to third parties Google doesn’t use customer data for advertising What does Gemini remember about me? Session memory for active tasks, semantic memory for structured business knowledge, procedural memory for workflows, and episodic memory of past actions across devices and channels. Lengthy jobs also run on their own secure machine in Google Cloud, so even if you log off for the day, Gemini has the work done when you get back. Which models can I use? Google Gemini models today, with additional models coming soon. Gemini uses automated routing to select the optimal model for speed, cost, and accuracy, all under one set of permissions and one bill. How can I try Gemini for my business? You can get started by contacting Google Cloud sales, or try Gemini Enterprise Plus edition at no cost for 30 days without sales assistance.
